//: Copy-paste detection for the hand-written code: the settings scripts/gates/gate-duplication.sh
runs jscpd with, against the baseline scripts/gates/baselines/duplication.json.
Which files: scripts/gates/jscpd-report.sh passes jscpd the tracked hand-written files
that scripts/gates/scope.py lists, by name, so this file names no path: an untracked
file is never read, and generated code is left out by scope.py's one list.
format: the hand-written Go, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript and shell code; the release
minLines and minTokens: a clone is reported when it spans at least 5 lines and 50
tokens: small enough to catch a copied test helper, such as a replay store or a codec.
threshold 0: any clone makes jscpd exit 1.
maxLines and maxSize are raised from jscpd's defaults (1000 lines, 100kb), which skip a
larger file without a word; several hand-written files here are longer than 1000 lines.
